defects.evidence: Clarify exactly what “owned” involved... Add an operational result if available... Without an outcome, this is weaker than the surrounding bullets.

“AI-first,” “accelerating delivery,” and “improving outcomes” are broad claims without evidence. Identify the actual practices introduced, who adopted them, and the measured delivery or quality change.
Change “12%” to **12 percentage points**. If using relative improvement instead, it is approximately 17%.
900 ms to 600 ms is a **33% reduction**, not 50%.
Simplify the method list. It currently delays the result and is difficult to scan.
Split this into at least two bullets. It currently combines: migration architecture, logging-library work, onboarding, weekend on-call ownership, backlog elimination.

GRPO generally requires multiple outputs per prompt to calculate group-relative advantages. The statement that each prompt or update used exactly one scored trajectory may sound technically impossible, especially after the previous bullet mentions grouped rollouts.
Resolve the tension between “single-request” inference and “dynamic batching.” Dynamic batching normally benefits concurrent requests, so the current wording may look contradictory.
Put the Oct 2024–May 2025 internship above the Aug 2022–Jul 2024 role. Experience should normally be reverse chronological.
